record_type_quote: Results replicated those of Henry and Cliffordson (2017) for initial hypotheses related to motivational selves; current and ideal selves were statistically significant predictors of effort, in line with prior studies in the Chinese context. However, results among this sample supported discrete constructs for ideal L2 and current L2 self and provide evidence of a separable sub-component of self-authenticity, digital self-authenticity.
